federal.name: Job Corps
federal.provides: Free residential and nonresidential training, including trade programs, with housing, meals, and a job placement focus.

federal.name: Registered Apprenticeship (DOL ETA Apprenticeship section)
federal.provides: DOL overview of the Registered Apprenticeship system; points to Apprenticeship.gov as the one-stop source for finding and starting apprenticeships.

federal.name: Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA) overview
federal.provides: DOL overview of WIOA, which funds adult and dislocated worker training, including Individual Training Accounts (ITAs) through American Job Centers. The fetched text did not describe ITAs in detail; follow linked pages.

federal.name: Reentry Employment Opportunities (REO)
federal.provides: DOL grant-funded programs helping justice-involved youth, young adults, and formerly incarcerated adults get workforce training and jobs.

federal.name: VA GI Bill benefits
federal.provides: GI Bill education benefits that can pay for on-the-job training, apprenticeships, and non-college degree programs.

federal.name: Veteran Readiness and Employment (VR&E, Chapter 31)
federal.provides: Vocational rehabilitation that can pay for training at vocational/technical schools, on-the-job training, and apprenticeships.

federal.name: Federal Pell Grant
federal.provides: Need-based federal grant for postsecondary education and training.

federal.name: Workforce Pell
federal.provides: Pell Grant funding for short-term workforce programs (8 to under 15 weeks, 150-599 clock hours), with governor and Department of Education approval and 70% completion and placement benchmarks, per search-result summaries of ED and FSA Partners materials.

federal.name: FAFSA
federal.provides: Free Application for Federal Student Aid; required for Pell Grants, federal loans and many state and school grants.

federal.name: CareerOneStop (funding and training finder; Apprenticeship finder)
federal.provides: DOL-run training and funding search tools, including Training Finder and links to American Job Center locations.

federal.name: Apprenticeship.gov (Apprenticeship Finder)
federal.provides: DOL site to search open Registered Apprenticeship job listings by keyword and location and to find programs taking new apprentices.

federal.name: American Job Centers (find a center)
federal.provides: Locator for local American Job Centers that provide WIOA training assistance and career services.

federal.name: YouthBuild
federal.provides: DOL-funded program combining construction-trade training with education for young people.

federal.name: SNAP Employment and Training (SNAP E&T)
federal.provides: USDA program that can pay for training, tuition, and supportive services for SNAP participants.

federal.name: Perkins V Career and Technical Education
federal.provides: Federal funding to state and local CTE programs, including trade and technical training at high schools and community colleges.
